**Requirement ids:** **`SIG-OPS-009`** (owner — cost truth: measured monthly
cost vs the operator's ceiling, alarmed; non-GCP lines read into the same
ledger; agent usage reported not capped). ·
**Base:** `r11/P34.4-alerts-that-reach-a-human` (chain tip — merge after it) ·
**Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/206_P34.5__cost-guard-budget-alert-billing-export.md live_verification=true` ·
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/206_P34.5__cost-guard-budget-alert-billing-export.md` (manifest row 206 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) ·
**Live stage:** production write — **pre-authorised** (S5-3 11A list, expires
GATE-G4) and **executed live 2026-10-02** (window: any time — billing
metadata; stop-rule check recorded in the run ledger: known-red probe class
only, last backups SUCCESSFUL, reads consistent → no void).

## What this does

Spend becomes visible and alarmed:

1. **Ceiling budget** — `SIG infra ceiling — 300 USD per month (U-008)`:
   300 USD, thresholds 50/90/100 % of CURRENT_SPEND, scoped
   `--filter-projects=projects/$SIG_GCP_PROJECT` (infrastructure only, A-2a —
   the account serves other projects), e-mail to billing IAM recipients +
   the committed operator channel. **Created live** — id
   `3511680b-9fc4-4025-880f-f7329f560c94`; post-state `--verify` →
   `ceiling-budget OK`.
2. **Test threshold** — `$0.01`, 100 %, same scope — created (id
   `9d3b59b0-8317-4b88-b035-741a1d5bb3ed`), fires against existing
   month-to-date spend; its delete leg is name-checked and refuses without
   `--fired-confirmed` (the operator's e-mail receipt is the human leg —
   D-P34.5-1; an agent never asserts it).
3. **Billing export** — dataset `sig_billing_export` created (US);
   `exportcheck` is the read-only row-count leg. The export *link* has no
   public API path — operator console step (OP-12, D-P34.5-2); first monthly
   report queued until rows exist (D-P34.5-3).
4. **Spend ledger** — `docs/build/reports/spend/`: `SPEND_LEDGER.md` rules +
   `spend_ledger.csv` + `agent_usage.csv` + `2026-10.md`. Labels
   `measured | operator-reported | estimate | pending`; the ~$90–100
   inference row stays `estimate` (superseded, never edited); agent usage is
   a separate file, never currency (OD-02/03/26); B-11's 40 GB cap recorded
   as an assumption.
5. **Pointers** — README deployed paragraph, `GCP_DEPLOYMENT.md`'s "$9/mo"
   (now labelled estimate) and `ops/README.md` all point at the ledger.

## Deviations

None beyond recorded owned decisions (ADR-193). The post-state verify's first
run flagged a false DRIFT (GCP stores the project filter as the project
*number*); the diff now resolves `projectNumber` — fix + regression test in
this PR.
